TRUE END / リフレーン. Choose 「……終わりじゃない。」 if it appears (independently printed by Fool and Rarin). CONDITIONAL FALLBACK IF IT DOES NOT APPEAR: the two other exact end-choice labels documented by Fool are 「蔵女と共に、生き続けよう。」 (END1) and 「お開きにしよう。」 (END2). Choose one of those ONLY if it is actually displayed; do not assume either is available on the 2015 Selection DVD. Complete that ending; if you chose END1, Fool documents a post-clear 「本編からはじめる」 no-choice CG scene, so view it before resetting. Do NOT follow this TRUE-specific next step unless TRUE was actually cleared. At the title use 「既視感」→「記憶を失う」 (new run; old saves cannot be reused), then work through this guide's END1 and END2 sections in order for their separately documented scenes/CG saves, even if one ending repeats. Following END2, reset memory once more and replay the TRUE section to try 「……終わりじゃない。」 again. A 2018 independent player reports seeing the third choice after the two others and resetting; Fool instead obtains TRUE first. This is a conservative documented-text recovery procedure, NOT verified proof of a fixed unlock requirement or 2015 Selection compatibility. If none of the three quoted choices appears, stop and report that version/state mismatch instead of guessing. Bonus 「狐の嫁入り」 is reported after TRUE (Fool notes possibly all endings).

After TRUE END, select 「本編からはじめる」 again for the no-choice CG recovery epilogue (NOT a normal new run). For 100% CGs, if you played with 「盲点」 OFF, plan a complete replay from a memory reset with 「盲点」 ON; do not assume turning it ON only for this final epilogue collects the missed bonus scenes. After all three main endings, open all five 「狐の嫁入り」 bonus stories once the title option appears. Avoid cross-run save loads.
